answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 50649 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Volume of the last Sajda Question: I am in Dubai, in my office there is an arrangement for prying namaz collectively. In fact our imam who is a native of Arab country, in all prayers the volume or size of last sajdah is very long than other sajdah. Is his this practice correct or not? Answer ID: 50649 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 447/357/B=03/1435) This practice of your imam is not appropriate. There should be balance between both the sajdahs. It is better to read the tasbih in ruku and sajdah 3-3 times. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
